mapper.sql: s.goods_id, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.draft_data, '$.goodsName')), s.goods_name) AS goods_name, COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.draft_data, '$.originalPrice')) AS DECIMAL(10,2)), s.original_price) AS original_price, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.draft_data, '$.category')), s.category) AS category, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.draft_data, '$.subtitle')), s.subtitle) AS subtitle, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.draft_data, '$.mainImage')), s.main_image) AS main_image, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.draft_data, '$.galleryImages')), CAST(s.gallery_images AS CHAR)) AS gallery_images, COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.draft_data, '$.salesCount')) AS SIGNED), s.sales_count) AS sales_count, COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.draft_data, '$.favorableRate')) AS DECIMAL(5,2)), s.favorable_rate) AS favorable_rate, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.draft_data, '$.serviceTags')), CAST(s.service_tags AS CHAR)) AS service_tags, COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.draft_data, '$.sortOrder')) AS SIGNED), s.sort_order) AS sort_order, s.status AS product_status, s.version, a.activity_id, a.activity_name, a.discount_id, a.group_type, a.take_limit_count, a.target, a.valid_time, a.status AS activity_status, a.start_time, a.end_time, d.discount_name, d.discount_desc, d.discount_type, d.market_plan, d.market_expr, d.tag_id, COALESCE(a.source, s.source) AS source, COALESCE(a.channel, s.channel) AS channel
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM sku s INNER JOIN sc_sku_activity r ON r.goods_id = s.goods_id AND r.source = s.source AND r.channel = s.channel AND r.status = 1 INNER JOIN group_buy_activity a ON a.activity_id = r.activity_id AND a.status = 1 AND a.start_time <= NOW() AND a.end_time > NOW() INNER JOIN group_buy_discount d ON d.discount_id = a.discount_id WHERE s.status = 1
AND (s.goods_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.subtitle LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND s.category = #{category}
ORDER BY
COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.draft_data, '$.salesCount')) AS SIGNED), s.sales_count) DESC, s.id DESC
CASE d.market_plan WHEN 'ZJ' THEN COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.draft_data, '$.originalPrice')) AS DECIMAL(10,2)), s.original_price) - CAST(d.market_expr AS DECIMAL(10,2)) WHEN 'MJ' THEN COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.draft_data, '$.originalPrice')) AS DECIMAL(10,2)), s.original_price) - CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(d.market_expr, ',', -1) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) WHEN 'N' THEN CAST(d.market_expr AS DECIMAL(10,2)) WHEN 'ZK' THEN FLOOR(COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.draft_data, '$.originalPrice')) AS DECIMAL(10,2)), s.original_price) * CAST(d.market_expr AS DECIMAL(10,4))) ELSE s.original_price END ASC, s.id DESC
CASE d.market_plan WHEN 'ZJ' THEN COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.draft_data, '$.originalPrice')) AS DECIMAL(10,2)), s.original_price) - CAST(d.market_expr AS DECIMAL(10,2)) WHEN 'MJ' THEN COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.draft_data, '$.originalPrice')) AS DECIMAL(10,2)), s.original_price) - CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(d.market_expr, ',', -1) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) WHEN 'N' THEN CAST(d.market_expr AS DECIMAL(10,2)) WHEN 'ZK' THEN FLOOR(COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.draft_data, '$.originalPrice')) AS DECIMAL(10,2)), s.original_price) * CAST(d.market_expr AS DECIMAL(10,4))) ELSE s.original_price END DESC, s.id DESC
s.sort_order DESC, s.id DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT FROM sku s LEFT JOIN group_buy_activity a ON a.id = ( SELECT MAX(a2.id) FROM group_buy_activity a2 WHERE a2.goods_id = s.goods_id ) LEFT JOIN group_buy_discount d ON d.discount_id = a.discount_id WHERE s.goods_id = #{goodsId} LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM sku s INNER JOIN sc_sku_activity r ON r.goods_id = s.goods_id AND r.source = s.source AND r.channel = s.channel AND r.status = 1 INNER JOIN group_buy_activity a ON a.activity_id = r.activity_id AND a.status = 1 AND a.start_time <= NOW() AND a.end_time > NOW() INNER JOIN group_buy_discount d ON d.discount_id = a.discount_id WHERE s.goods_id = #{goodsId} AND s.status = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT goods_id, goods_name, original_price, category, subtitle, main_image, CAST(gallery_images AS CHAR) AS gallery_images, sales_count, favorable_rate, CAST(service_tags AS CHAR) AS service_tags, sort_order, status AS product_status, version, source, channel FROM sku WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId}

SELECT FROM sku s INNER JOIN group_buy_activity a ON a.goods_id = s.goods_id AND a.status = 0 INNER JOIN group_buy_discount d ON d.discount_id = a.discount_id WHERE s.goods_id = #{goodsId} ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM sku s INNER JOIN sc_sku_activity r ON r.goods_id = s.goods_id AND r.source = s.source AND r.channel = s.channel AND r.status = 1 INNER JOIN group_buy_activity a ON a.activity_id = r.activity_id INNER JOIN group_buy_discount d ON d.discount_id = a.discount_id WHERE s.goods_id = #{goodsId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sku ( source, channel, goods_id, goods_name, original_price, category, subtitle, main_image, gallery_images, sales_count, favorable_rate, service_tags, sort_order, status, version, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{source}, #{channel}, #{goodsId}, #{goodsName}, #{originalPrice}, #{category}, #{subtitle}, #{mainImage}, #{galleryImages}, #{salesCount}, #{favorableRate}, #{serviceTags}, #{sortOrder}, #{productStatus}, 0, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE sku SET version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId} AND version = #{version}

UPDATE sku SET source = #{source}, channel = #{channel}, goods_name = #{goodsName}, original_price = #{originalPrice}, category = #{category}, subtitle = #{subtitle}, main_image = #{mainImage}, gallery_images = #{galleryImages}, sales_count = #{salesCount}, favorable_rate = #{favorableRate}, service_tags = #{serviceTags}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{productStatus}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId} AND version = #{version}
UPDATE group_buy_activity SET status = 3, update_time = NOW() WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId} AND status = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_buy_discount ( discount_id, discount_name, discount_desc, discount_type, market_plan, market_expr, tag_id, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{discountId}, #{discountName}, #{discountDesc}, #{discountType}, #{marketPlan}, #{marketExpr}, #{tagId}, NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT INTO group_buy_activity ( activity_id, activity_name, discount_id, group_type, take_limit_count, target, valid_time, status, start_time, end_time, tag_id, tag_scope, goods_id, source, channel, config_version, draft_data, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{activityId}, #{activityName}, #{discountId}, #{groupType}, #{takeLimitCount}, #{target}, #{validTime}, #{activityStatus}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{tagId}, NULL, #{goodsId}, #{source}, #{channel}, #{version}, #{draftData}, NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT INTO sc_sku_activity ( source, channel, activity_id, goods_id, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{source}, #{channel}, #{activityId}, #{goodsId}, 1, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE activity_id = VALUES(activity_id), status = 1, update_time = NOW()
